title: Platform package config
description: Title metadata for one platform that distributes an installable package: identity, store-front presentation and achievements. Describes the GAME, not the hardware - the cook list under engine/config/<name>/ is the hardware half. See docs/vita/PACKAGING.md.

allOf.description: Only the containers that carry a title identifier require one; a homebrew nx executable has none.

platform.description: Platform family this config applies to, lower case.

id.description: Nine characters: four author characters then five digits. Also names the writable data directory. Supplied by the shared title declaration, not written here; a variant may still override the name. Required of the platforms whose containers carry one.

author.description: Who made the title, as a launcher shows it. Supplied by the shared title declaration's developer, not written here.

safe.description: Restrict the executable to the ordinary user API. Clear only if the title genuinely needs more.

extended_memory.description: Request the larger main-memory allowance. Off by default; the engine budget fits comfortably without it.

extra.description: Raw metadata key-values passed through unchanged. Integers become DWORDs, strings become strings.

nro.description: nx homebrew executable container metadata. The name, author and version come from the shared title declaration. See docs/nx/PACKAGING.md.

icon.description: 256x256 JPEG the launcher shows beside the name.

eboot.description: PSP container slots. The container is a fixed sequence of slots and an absent one is filled with a placeholder rather than omitted, so the reader emits them positionally.

icon.description: 144x80 PNG shown in the system menu.

overlay.description: 480x272 PNG drawn over the menu background. Optional.

picture.description: 480x272 PNG background for the menu entry.

livearea.description: Store-front presentation. Image sizes are exact and are checked before packaging; see docs/vita/PACKAGING.md.

startup.description: 280x158 indexed; the only layer that may be transparent.

style.description: Layout used when generating a template: a1 centres the startup image, psmobile right-aligns it.

template.description: A hand-written layout, used verbatim. Generated from 'style' when absent.

trophies.description: Achievements. Requires software the player installs, and never reaches the online service - see docs/subsystems/ACHIEVEMENT.md.

np_communication_id.description: Declared, not allocated. Must match the identifier baked into the pack.

trp.description: A pre-built pack, staged as-is. Mutually exclusive with 'list'.

icon.description: The set's own icon, packed as ICON0.PNG and distinct from the per-trophy icons. Defaults to the store-front icon when absent.

detail.description: The set's description, shown beside its name. Defaults to the title name.

list.description: Trophy definitions, from which the pack is generated. Mutually exclusive with 'trp'.

files.description: Extra content staged into the package. Adding content here rather than in the build fragment keeps what ships described in one place.

variants.description: Per-variant overrides, deep-merged over the base. Keyed by the lower-case platform name.
